description:
Edwards Air Force Base is hosting the 2nd Annual Bridging Opportunities & Leveraging Talent (B.O.L.T.) Construction/Services Industry Days on April 08-09, 2026. The purpose of Industry Days is to educate our construction/services industry partners on doing business with Edwards AFB, enhance potential offerors’ understanding of Edwards AFB’s mission, and educate on the Government’s requirements for various projects related to construction to support Edwards AFB with anticipated execution in fiscal year 2026 and beyond.

As we continue to plan, updates will be posted in the SAM announcement.

Welcoming Construction Contractors such as:

  • Paint
  • Demolition
  • Abatement
  • HVAC
  • Electrical
  • High Voltage Electrical
  • Paving
  • Plumbing
  • Specialty Contractors and more!

Welcoming Service Contractors such as:

  • Grounds Maintenance
  • Flooring
  • Fire Alarm Systems
  • Spills and Scheduled Cleanup
  • Elevator Maintenance
  • Propane
  • Underground Storage
  • And more!
